digests.method: SHA-256 of canonical JSON equivalent to json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")), encoded as UTF-8. Arrays retain order.
digests.shared_projection_definition: For each view, preserve mode and figure_ids; replace stem by its ordered dollar-delimited TeX spans; preserve each option's id, figure_ids and ordered TeX spans. Preserve question and option array order.
